html:
Overview

A depot is an area where players can store their items in a Locker. Every locker contains a Depot Chest, the player's Supply Stash, their Inbox, as well as access to the Market. Lockers are available for individual players to store their items securely.

Locations

Depots are present in most towns and villages throughout the world. However, Rookgaard, Dawnport, and the Island of Destiny don't have a depot. While every hometown has a depot, smaller villages like Krailos, Feyrist, Moonfall, and Silvertides also offer access to your depot. Additionally, there are two depot slots on Travora's ship and one in every Guildhall.

Functionality

Depots serve as the central hub within most towns, often found bustling with player activity. Historically each city's depot used to be unique and not accessible from any other settlements, however since the introduction of the global depot and Depot Boxes in the 2015 Winter Update all depot slots are now interconnected. Free Account players can store a total of 2,000 items across all depot boxes, whereas Premium players can store 15,000.

Depot Buildings and Features

Each city's depot varies in design and features. Venore and Kazordoon (Kazordoon city and Gnomegate) are currently the only towns with 2 depot buildings, but in both cases there is only one Depot Box assigned to both depots. In Marapur there are two depot buildings, one at Silvertides and another at Moonfall, and two new Depot Boxes were added corresponding with them.
